+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command,roles,collections,warning,verbose', [
+    (['install'], True, True, False, False),
+    (['install', '-p', 'custom_roles'], True, False, True, False),
+    (['role', 'install'], True, False, False, True),
+    (['role', 'install', '-p', 'custom_roles'], True, False, False, True),
+    (['collection', 'install'], False, True, False, False),
+])
+def test_mixed_requirements_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch, command, roles, collections, warning, verbose):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path.joinpath('requirements.yml'))
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- geerlingguy.docker\ncollections:\n- namespace.collection\n')
+
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    mock_warning = MagicMock()
+    mock_verbose = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', collection_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.utils.display.Display, 'warning', mock_warning)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.utils.display.Display, 'vvv', mock_verbose)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+    assert role_install.called is roles
+    assert collection_install.called is collections
+    if collections:
+        assert collection_install.call_args[0][0] == [('namespace.collection', '*', None)]
+    if warning:
+        assert 'cannot be installed to a roles path' in mock_warning.call_args[0][0]
+    if verbose:
+        assert 'collections which will be ignored' in mock_verbose.call_args[0][0]
+
+
+def test_empty_requirements_skip_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path.joinpath('requirements.yml'))
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('{}\n')
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', collection_install)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+    assert not role_install.called
+    assert not collection_install.called
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_role_requirements_file_extension_is_validated(tmp_path):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path.joinpath('requirements.txt'))
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('{}\n')
+
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='Invalid role requirements file'):
+        GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+
+def test_collection_install_reports_skipped_roles(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path.joinpath('requirements.yml'))
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- geerlingguy.docker\ncollections:\n- namespace.collection\n')
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', collection_install)

+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'collection', 'install', '-r', requirements_file]).run()
